Marta_Sales: Passing SilverGate Diagnostics to CS/Eng. Signed today. TL;DR:
- Private deployment (EU region), dedicated pool.
- Ingests: nightly SFTP batch (CSV) + realtime webhooks from devices.
- SSO: SAML (IdP).
- Audit: 7yr retention + HSM-backed keys.
- Pilot load: ~60 QPS steady realtime, nightly batch spikes ~220 QPS for 30m.
- Renewal: 9 months; high churn risk if pilot timeline slips.

Evan_CSM: Thanks Marta. Adding eng/support. Primary onboarding contact? Also please drop signed SOW + DPA.

Marta_Sales: Contact: rachel.yang@silvergatedx.com (Onboarding Lead). SOW: https://drive.redwood/silvergate/sow_signed.pdf  DPA in same folder.

Diego_Support: I'll own VPC peering/runbook and firewall rules. Quick Q: private control plane hosted in their VPC or are they expecting inbound-only endpoints? That affects NAT/egress.

Marta_Sales: They asked for managed private control plane in their VPC (peered).

Sana_Eng: For webhooks I need sample payloads, auth method (Bearer? HMAC?), and retry semantics. For CSVs: max file size & frequency. I'll also draft capacity plan for dedicated pool.

Evan_CSM: Rachel said webhooks use HMAC-SHA256 + per-device keys. CSVs: nightly batches ~150 files, ~30MB each. ETA for docs: Rachel will share sample payloads by EOD tomorrow.

Diego_Support: Actions I'll take:
- Create support ticket SUP-9033 and upload peering checklist (owner: Diego_Support) (ETA: 48h)
- Publish firewall/port list + sample iptables (ETA: 48h)
- Share private control plane onboarding runbook template (ETA: 72h)

Sana_Eng: Eng actions:
- Create ENG-1402 for webhook receiver + CSV ingestor (owner: Sana_Eng) (initial spike: 2 days once samples received)
- Capacity doc + sizing recs for dedicated pool (owner: Sana_Eng) (ETA: 4 business days)
- KV caching suggestion for repeated device prompts to reduce token costs (owner: Sana_Eng)

Evan_CSM: Owners & ETAs summary:
- Kickoff scheduling: Evan_CSM (ETA: tomorrow)
- IdP metadata collection: Rachel + Evan_CSM (ETA: 72h)
- Support runbook & peering doc: Diego_Support (48h)
- Eng connector + capacity draft: Sana_Eng (4bd after samples)

Marta_Sales: Flagging risk: they require HSM KMS before pilot signing off. If procurement delays KMS, pilot may stall. Please surface procurement blocker early.

Evan_CSM: Noted. I'll add KMS procurement as a tracked risk and request weekly updates. I'll also define pilot success metrics (ingest 95p sustained for 24h, batch error rate <0.5%, time-to-first-query <4min).

CalendarBot: Meeting scheduled: "SilverGate Onboarding Kickoff" Tue 09:00 CET 024-05-14. Invites: Marta_Sales, Evan_CSM, Diego_Support, Sana_Eng, rachel.yang@silvergatedx.com

Diego_Support: Created SUP-9033: https://support.redwood/t/SUP-9033. I'll post runbook when uploaded.

Sana_Eng: I'll start a 1-day parser spike after Rachel sends samples and update ENG-1402.

Evan_CSM: Great. I'll post the onboarding tracker link after the kickoff and set weekly sync cadence. Ping here to reassign owners. :handshake:
